M1.reason: Against the brief's words: upright-to-hunched scientist in the side and front-left views (head pushed forward, shoulders rounded), long arms reaching out and down in the front, back and top views, and a torn coat hanging from the shoulders. The outline reads as the brief describes it, with no part sticking out or missing in any of the ten views.

M2.reason: Height measures 68.4 against the 68 asked, 0.6% off, well within 15%. Width 38.5 and length 53.8 are not asked for and are not charged.

M3.reason: Parts the brief names, checked in sides.png and attack.png: the parasite mass over the head (tan, lobed, in front, left, back and top views), long clawed hands with several claws on each hand (front, back and front-left views), the torn bloodied lab coat with the chest opened to show ribs (front and back views), and two legs in shoes. None is missing or doubled. Claws and the coat's torn edges are the small parts, and both are present.

M4.reason: Regions match what the brief asks: off-white coat with red blood on it, dark red-brown skin on the hands and claws, a tan parasite head, dark red-brown shoes. Each region reads as its material at the sheet's scale, with no region in a wrong colour.

M5.reason: The brief's bloodiness and damage are there in their places: blood smears down the coat and legs (front, back and front-left views), the torn chest opening with ribs and a dark cavity (front and back views), and the stained sleeves. Sharpness is in line with the other detail on the figure.

M6.reason: Capped at 2 by the line-up test, measured apart: the asset was picked as not made by Valve 0 of 4 times (judges picked A, B, B, A where it stood at B, D, D, B), so it passed for one of the game's.

M7.reason: Upright in the front view, facing the viewer, with feet at the floor line in the side, walk and attack frames, so it stands on its origin as the brief's figure does. The forward lean is a pose, not a facing fault.

M8.reason: SMAK check errors are empty. 844 triangles: over the third quartile (731) but under twice the median (1008), so it fails neither way and is not charged. Nothing visible is open, inside out or floating; the underside in the BELOW view is not something a player sees. The chest cavity reads as painted surface, not a hole.

C1.reason: In walk.png and attack.png every part stays on the body through the frames: arms swing and the claws trail (walk 17/59, attack 20/35), the head and parasite stay on, and the feet stay on the floor line in every frame. Nothing comes apart, sinks or floats.
